test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man takes a loan of ₹15,000 from a bank at 8% compound interest per annum, compounded annually. Find the total amount he has to pay after 2 years.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use CI multiplying factor: (1 + r/100)t

Here factor = (1.08)² = 1.1664

Amount = 15000 × 1.1664

**∴ Answer = 17496**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal = 15000

Rate = 8% per annum

Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)t

 
• Start 1 yr 2 yr 15000 ×1.08 ×1.08 

**Calculations:**

⇒ A = 15000 × (1 + 8/100)²

⇒ A = 15000 × (1.08)²

⇒ A = 15000 × 1.1664

⇒ A = 17496

**∴ The correct answer is 17496.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Formula

A = P(1 + r/100)t, where interest = A − P.

Successive Multiplication Trick

For multiple years, multiply principal by (1 + r/100) repeatedly.

Difference between SI and CI

CI grows faster as interest is added to principal each year.

Effective Rate Concept

For 2 years, effective increase = (1.08)² − 1 = 16.64%.
